The paper is accepted_with_cautions because dbAMP activity text remains a preserved source_conflict and local supplementary-named files are article landing HTML rather than true supplementary data.

caution_findings.resolution: Preserved as source_conflict; DBAASP and primary Table 1 rows remain source_verified where values match.

caution_findings.resolution: Final claims use source-supported XML/PDF main-text tables, methods, and figure captions only; exact all-strain supplementary curves are not claimed.

caution_findings.resolution: Mechanism ontology records are limited to source-stated assay type, direction, selected reported values, and limitations.

per_layer_decision_rationale.review_closeout: The previous targeted rework ticket is closed because source-supported activity/database/mechanism rows are now represented and the remaining limitations are explicit cautions rather than blocking omissions.
